jobs.description:

With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Description
We are seeking an experienced System Architect for an assignment with an automotive client in Södertälje, Sweden.
What You Will Work On
Develop, maintain, and improve governing documents, guidelines, and processes for the EE platform.
Ensure documentation is structured, consistent, version-controlled, and aligned with internal requirements and applicable regulations.
Translate technical requirements, architectural principles, and ways of working into clear, practical documentation.
Manage the documentation lifecycle, including creation, review, alignment, implementation, and compliance follow-up.
Collaborate with R&D teams, adjacent technical domains, system owners, and external partners.
Harmonise documentation standards and ways of working across teams.
Improve traceability, information quality, and document governance in a complex automotive environment.

What You Bring
Proven experience in document management, requirements documentation, process development, or governing documentation in technically complex environments.
Experience working in large organisations with established development processes and ways of working.
Good understanding of embedded systems, automotive electronics, or software-intensive environments.
Ability to structure, review, and quality-assure complex technical information.
Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Ability to understand complex systems holistically and maintain clarity, consistency, and traceability in documentation.

Meritorious
Experience with EE architecture, Software Defined Vehicles (SDV), or system platforms.
Experience in large-scale automotive R&D organisations.
Knowledge of version control, change management, quality documentation, and compliance processes.
Experience working across multiple technical teams and stakeholder groups.
Experience in autonomous vehicle technologies and/or fuel cell systems.

About the job

Company Description Integra Management AB is a project management-focused company established in Gothenburg, Sweden, in 2025. The organization helps companies manage projects efficiently by providing comprehensive solutions that streamline operations and enhance productivity. Integra Management AB adheres to global project management standards, including PMP® methodology and best practices, to deliver reliable and high-value services across sectors. With strong expertise in Oracle Unifier and advanced project controls, the company supports clients in achieving greater visibility, control, and success in capital projects. Integra Management AB is dedicated to empowering teams with the tools and knowledge needed to transform how projects are managed and delivered.Role Description We're looking for a Cost Controller to join us at Integra Management ABSome people see a budget as a spreadsheet. We're looking for someone who sees the story behind the numbers: where the money is going, why, and what that means for the weeks ahead.In this role you'll be the person the team turns to when they want to know how the project is really doing financially. You'll keep track of costs and forecasts, help the team understand what changes will actually cost, and turn complex data into reports and dashboards that people can act on. You'll work closely with planning, procurement and finance, so you'll be at the heart of how the project is run.What we think will help you succeed:Several years of experience in cost control, cost engineering or a similar role on larger projects. The industry matters less than the experience.
A good understanding of budgets, forecasting and Earned Value
Confidence in Excel and cost tools such as SAP, EcoSys or similar. Power BI experience is a bonus.
Familiarity with different contract types and how they affect cost
Good English and the ability to explain numbers clearly to people who aren't numbers people

At Zool Engineering, part of HiQ, our focus is on you. We believe that putting people first is fundamental to delivering exceptional results. We highly value your mindset, ambition, technical expertise, and ability to solve complex problems. While we are eager to learn about your professional journey so far, we are even more interested in your future aspirations — and how we might support you in achieving them as part of the Zool (and HiQ) team.
We are now looking for a skilled embedded developer who wants to help shape the future with us. Are you a curious problem-solver who thrives in a team that enjoys having fun at work while creating real value for our clients? Then we’d love to hear from you.
We’re looking for someone with:
A relevant academic degree
5+ years of experience working with C or C++
Fluent communication skills in English
Basic proficiency in spoken and written Swedish
A passion for technology – and for people
Ai Experience in daily work

Experience with Python and Linux, as well as previous work in the automotive industry, is considered a plus.
Why Zool (and HiQ)?
Zool is a team of high-performing system developers with deep technical expertise across all levels of software development – from customized AUTOSAR platforms to backend and cloud-based solutions. As part of the HiQ family, you get the best of both worlds: Zool’s cutting-edge capabilities and HiQ’s powerful network of tech hubs across Europe.
Together, we offer:
Exciting projects at the forefront of technology
Talented and humble colleagues
A culture built on (e)quality, transparency, and continuous improvement
Opportunities for continuous growth – both technically and personally
A platform where you can make a real impact through tech

Om jobbet
To support our continued growth, we are looking for a Service Technician with solution- and customer-oriented mindset, to join our strong team in Skänninge, Sweden.
Your Key Responsibilities
You are responsible for the service and maintenance on our products at our customers’ premises throughout the country and at our own workshop in Skänninge. You’ll be part of a team of Service Technicians, and your colleagues are currently based in Gothenburg, Stockholm and Sollefteå. Our strategy is for each technician to address the region around where they are based. At this time, we are looking for someone located in proximity to Skänninge.
Performing scheduled service, maintenance and repair work planned by the Service Coordinator.
Assisting in spare parts management and planning, in accordance with the process.
Documenting and reporting completed service assignments daily.
Providing consulting and advisory services to our customers.
Working in close cooperation with internal stakeholders.

Your profile
Relevant education (electrician, electronics technician, heavy machine mechanic or similar).
Experience in electronics, mechanics and hydraulics within vehicle engineering.
Ability to interpret manuals, technical specifications and drawings.
A genuine interest in machines and workshop work.
Good social skills.
Comfortable contacting your colleagues, even across national borders, for technical support by phone.
B-driving licence.
Willing to travel for work, also overnight.
Good Swedish and English language skills, both spoken and written.

While not strictly required, but will help you succeed in this role:
Experience in pneumatics, welding, calibration, updating software and control systems.
Experience of using vacuum sweepers.
Occupational safety and Electrical safety certificates.
C-driving license.

We offer You
Competitive terms of employment.
A dedicated and competent team.
Opportunities for personal and professional development.

At Aebi Schmidt you will become part of a leading international company with a strong local presence.

Job Overview
Role Summary
An experienced Function Architect is needed to support software and functional changes within a complex embedded development environment. The role operates early in the development lifecycle, taking initiatives from initial ideas through to agreed technical solutions. You will work across technical and business-facing stakeholder groups to establish shared understanding of requirements, dependencies, system concepts, and the impact of proposed changes across the platform.
Key Responsibilities
Support the definition and implementation of software and functional changes in a complex embedded environment.
Work early in the development flow to translate ideas and requirements into agreed technical solutions and system concepts.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders, system owners, and affected technical teams to gather requirements and identify dependencies.
Facilitate technical discussions concerning system changes, interfaces, communication flows, and cross-system impacts.
Create alignment between technical and non-technical stakeholders throughout the change process.
Document agreed solutions using the established architecture toolchain.
Contribute to a structured, flow-oriented approach to embedded software change and delivery processes.
Explain technical solutions and working methods clearly, and support colleagues through pragmatic coaching where needed.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Strong understanding of complex embedded system architectures and cross-platform dependencies.
Experience with function development, system development, or system ownership in embedded environments.
Knowledge of in-vehicle or embedded communication technologies, including CAN and/or Ethernet, is advantageous.
Experience with continuous delivery and change processes for embedded software is beneficial.
Ability to document technical concepts and decisions within an architecture toolchain.

Qualifications & Experience
You have a B.Sc. and/or M.Sc. in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. You bring solid experience from function development, system development, or system ownership in an embedded setting. Experience from complex automotive or embedded engineering environments is considered advantageous. The role requires fluent English and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to diverse stakeholder groups.

Support the stability, resilience, and availability of business-critical mainframe systems.

Investigate technical issues across databases, transactions, and related systems.
Contribute to operational reliability and continuous improvement.

What You Bring
Extensive hands-on experience administering, configuring, and optimising IMS databases.
Several years of experience working in IBM z/OS environments.
Experience with transaction processing and performance analysis.
Strong knowledge of TSO/ISPF.
Experience supporting large, complex, business-critical environments with strict availability and resilience requirements.
Excellent English communication skills.
An analytical, structured, pragmatic, and solution-oriented approach.
Ability to collaborate effectively with other technical specialists.

Meritorious
Experience with IMS backup and recovery.
Understanding of how IMS transactions and databases interact with application code, such as COBOL.
Experience in banking or other highly regulated, security-critical environments.
Knowledge of related mainframe technologies, including IBM MQ, DB2, and WebSphere/Liberty.

About the role
We are looking for a Data Center Engineer to support the installation, operation and maintenance of data center infrastructure. You will help ensure that servers, storage, networks and supporting facilities operate securely and reliably.
You will work closely with infrastructure teams, facilities specialists and external vendors to resolve incidents, deliver changes and maintain service availability.
Key responsibilities
Install, configure and maintain servers, storage systems and network equipment.

Perform rack-and-stack activities, hardware replacements and structured cabling.

Monitor infrastructure health, investigate faults and coordinate incident resolution.

Support operating system maintenance, patching and hardware lifecycle management.

Carry out approved changes using documented procedures, validation checks and rollback plans.

Support backup, recovery and disaster recovery activities.

Maintain asset inventories, rack layouts, cabling records and operational documentation.

Coordinate with facilities teams on power, cooling, environmental monitoring and physical security.

Work with vendors on maintenance, equipment deliveries and hardware support.

Follow access controls, safety procedures and change management processes.

Participate in scheduled maintenance and on-call support where required.

Required qualifications
Relevant experience in data center operations, infrastructure support or a similar technical role.

Hands-on knowledge of server hardware, storage and networking fundamentals.

Experience with Linux and/or Windows Server environments.

Understanding of virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper-V or KVM.

Familiarity with fiber and copper cabling, rack infrastructure and hardware diagnostics.

Understanding of incident management, change management and operational documentation.

Strong troubleshooting, communication and organizational skills.

Ability to work independently and collaborate with technical teams and vendors.

Professional working proficiency in English.

Preferred qualifications
Experience with SAN/NAS storage, backup platforms or disaster recovery testing.

Familiarity with infrastructure monitoring and Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools.

Scripting or automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python or Ansible.

Exposure to cloud connectivity and hybrid infrastructure.

Relevant certifications in networking, servers, virtualization or IT service management.

Software Tester role within VCT EE I/T focused on Complete Vehicle Integration Test SIL/HIL testing. The role covers the entire testing lifecycle and contributes to the continuous improvement of test methods and environments to ensure Scania's embedded electrical systems meet high quality and safety standards.

Perform complete vehicle tests and verify complete electrical systems from a SW integration perspective (~20-30SW deliveries/4week).
Execute integration tests for both new and existing functionality.
Participate in the full test cycle, including:
Test planning
Test leadership
Test execution
Fault analysis
Contribute to the continuous improvement of test methods and test environments for current and future functionality.
Verify functionality and quality through SIL/HIL testing activities.
Support efforts to ensure Scania's embedded electrical systems are safe and of high quality for customers.

Education (Must Have/Nice To Have):
Must Have:
Engineering background within Mechanical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.

Verification and/or Validation experience.
Python experience.
Experience performing testing activities and fault analysis.
ISTQB certification.

Nice To Have:
Experience with SIL/HIL testing.
Experience with complete vehicle integration testing.
Experience working with electrical systems from an integration perspective.

Language:
Must Have:
English

Personal / Soft Skills:
Analytical and systematic approach to problem solving.
Good and precise communication skills.
Interest in understanding root causes of issues.
Interest in testing and technology.
Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment.

All about the role:

As aftermarket sales Product Owner, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining business processes to ensure efficiency and compliance for aftermarket sales and services. You will be part of the product team within IT EMEA/APAC, working cross-functionally with product, engineering and bunsiess owners to ensure that our products meet the needs of our customers and align with our business goals.

You will work closely with business stakeholders to define requirements for the core commerce platform, manage the sales backlog, monitor development team deliveries, and coordinate cross-functional dependencies with Contact Centers, Service Operations, Finance, Online Services, and B2B Operations.

 

What you'll do:

Provide guidance to engineering and commercial teams on process-related matters and foster a culture of process and product excellence.
Mirror Key Users (KU) in the markets and responsible for running KU forums. Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify process and product improvement opportunities.
Work with technical teams to ensure processes are supported by appropriate tools and systems.
Ensure processes facilitate smooth delivery of product features across the product areas.
Monitor product performance, business adoption and business & tech KPIs to implement corrective actions when necessary.
Consolidate the sales backlog across multiple product areas. Manage process-related tasks and prioritize improvements based on business impact.
Support with developing a roadmap for process enhancements to support organizational goals.
Create and update process documentation, analyse the requirments and transfer it into detailed requirement specification for development team, support commercial counterparts centrally and locally to drive adoption of standardized processes across the organization.

 

Who you are:

You have a strong understanding of cross-functional business processes, systems, and postpurchase operations, with knowledge of sales, service, and financial flows and have proven experience working in product team. You are a hands-on problem solver who can translate business needs into process improvements and solutions that drive commercial growth.

Qualifications:

To be successful in this role, we believe that you have good prioritization skills and the ability to go into details without losing focus of the bigger picture.
3+ years as Process Owner/Product Owner or similar role in digital solutions supporting aftermarket sales, service, finance
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
Strong product mindset and understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working in Agile teams.
Proficiency in Jira and/or Github for managing product backlogs and sprints.
In-depth knowledge of aftermarket sales processes (sales orders, payments, invoicing, refunds) related to services, extended warranties, spares, consumables & accessories
Understanding of fulfillment and logistics processes, especially in the context of spare parts, consumables and accessories is a plus
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Curious, self motivated and problem solver
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast-paced environment.
Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills
In-depth knowledge of the sales & distribution and finance domain in SAP (e.g. SD/GL/AP) would be beneficial
